invented.quote: That is about one day in every eight.
invented.why: The brief states the elevator was out for 41 days 'this year,' but does not give the current date (only that September has passed), so the total number of days elapsed this year cannot be calculated to be around 328.

invented.quote: Five months later, you are telling us the same thing: six to eight weeks.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the current month is November or that five months have passed since June, only that September has already occurred.
